info.name: Git Theme
info.summary: GitHub-style theme for the Nextcloud Files app
info.description: GitHub-style theme for the Nextcloud Files app: the file list (toolbar + table) is wrapped in a single centered 1012px card, harmonized with the README card rendered by the files_readmemd plugin. The login page gets the same card look and the guest footer (slogan + "Create your own free account") is hidden on non-authenticated pages. Only stable Nextcloud CSS variables are used, so both light and dark themes adapt automatically.
info.author: mat
